task_message:
Case N15: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 141x141x133 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Case N15 is finished. Summary of what I did:

- **Localized the lesion** with axial, coronal and sagittal overview sheets: a large, lobulated, strongly T2-hyperintense mass in the posterior soft tissues (subcutaneous/along the fascial plane, bulging the skin contour) on the patient's right side, spanning roughly 47 mm craniocaudal, 39 mm AP and 55 mm transverse.
- **Seeded the model** on the two bright lobules at the slice where the mass was largest (axial 52), obtaining a single-component mask (~38 mL).
- **Verified the boundary** in all three planes at high zoom (axial 32/47/60/70, coronal 40/50/60, sagittal 100/112/120) and ran one `seg_refine` (stable: 38.1 mL).
- **Reviewed the final candidate corrections** (C1–C5): C1/C2 were large regions of peritumoral edema/fat, C3–C4 were vessels, C5 distant skin/bright tissue — all rejected, none included.
- Final review showed no lesion tissue in the past-the-mask end panels (axial 18/81, coronal 8/63, sagittal 60/131), so the mask was saved with medium confidence.
